items.title: Can HP (HPQ) Stay Below Fair Value After Its 31% Run?

With the market already rewarding the story, the question is how well the current price reflects those future cash flows. items.title: Earnings Preview Could Be A Game Changer For HP (HPQ)
items.summary: HP Inc. has amended its bylaws to expand the board from 12 to 13 seats and confirmed Emma Walmsley will become Chief Executive Officer on January 4, 2027, with Bruce Broussard moving from Interim CEO to Chair of the Board and Chip Bergh remaining as a director. The leadership transition arrives just ahead of HP’s November 24, 2026 earnings release.
